entities.name: Louis Antoine de Pardaillan de Gondrin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Antoine de Pardaillan was a French nobleman, marquis of Antin, Gondrin and Montespan, and first Duke of Antin. He was Superintendent, director-general of the Bâtiments du Roi between 1708 and 1736.
